reasons: The corrected negative theorem uses a new direct dependency on the already-proved output-soundness theorem and states an explicit obstruction rather than the refuted universal completeness claim.

narrow: The original implication is false. A legal two-variable cyclic SCM with three independent private binary sources has supplied cells equal to the three pairwise products of their success probabilities and has a positive-denominator conditional counterfactual target equal to one source probability. The target is uniform on every positive observed fiber but is algebraic of degree two, not rational, in the supplied cells.
